title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for May of 2026
summary:
We are pleased to bring you the Congress.gov enhancements for May of 2026

Enhancement – House Roll Call Votes – 116th Congress

  • House roll call votes from the 116th Congress (2019-2020) are available to browse and search.
  • Use the House Roll Call Votes link in the Congressional Activity section of the Browse page to view a sortable list.
  • Learn more at About House Votes.

Enhancement – Concurrent Resolutions – Browse

  • Browse a list of concurrent resolutions published in the United States Statutes at Large.
  • Select a Congress between the 93rd and 116th from the Browse page. Open the Legislation by Actions section to find the link to Concurrent Resolutions Agreed to by House and Senate.
